# teams_online_voice_routing_policy (Resource)

Manages the OnlineVoiceRoutingPolicy policy via New-CsOnlineVoiceRoutingPolicy / Get-CsOnlineVoiceRoutingPolicy / Set-CsOnlineVoiceRoutingPolicy / Remove-CsOnlineVoiceRoutingPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `online_pstn_usages` (String) Maps to the -OnlinePstnUsages parameter.
- `route_type` (String) Maps to the -RouteType parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
